concept: A bright salt-air shoreline garden shaped by unhurried beach visits, smooth shells, and sunlit sea glass.
floor: One broad uninterrupted expanse of smooth sun-warmed sand across the full top face, with gentle large-scale shading but no visible grains, ripples, paving, grass, or scattered shells.
main_structure: One broad open-front shell cabana at the rear with a few oversized scalloped canopy bands, warm cream supports, and one large sea-glass blue inset.
rear_props: one chunky driftwood-style bench with a single oversized pearl cushion
side_props: one large folded beach umbrella and one smooth shell planter on the upper-left edge
one shallow rounded blue rock pool and two broad sea-grass forms on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth sea-glass parapet made from broad rounded masses, without shell or coral texture

materials: a few broad translucent-looking sea-glass blocks

lighting: soft bright coastal daylight with a warm sunlit rim and two broad pearl-lantern glows
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open sand
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, text, watermark, external shadow
sand grains, foam flecks, tiny shells, tiny coral, flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
